1. AgriTrack
I. General Information Project Title: AgriTrack: A low-cost soil moisture and irrigation alert system for smallholder vegetable farmers
Startup Name: Bukid Insights Co. Date Established: January 15, 2024.
Total Funding Requested: PHP 620,000.00 Project Duration: 8 months

II. Problem Smallholder vegetable farmers in the uplands of Balamban rely on guesswork for watering schedules, leading to crop loss. A 2025 municipal agriculture survey found 48% of highland vegetable plots suffered yield loss from over- or under-watering in the past cropping season.

III. Solution AgriTrack is a solar-powered soil sensor paired with a lightweight SMS alert system, requiring no smart phone or data plan, that texts farmers when soil moisture drops below or rises above the safe threshold for their planted crop.

IV. Target Market Smallholder vegetable farmers in the highland barangays of Balamban and Asturias, starting with the 85 farmer-members of the Balamban Vegetable Growers Cooperative.

V. Objectives 1.) Deploy 50 sensor units across pilot farms by Month 3
2.) Reduce reported over/under-watering incidents among pilot farms by 40% by Month 6. 3.) Onboard 200 farmer accounts by Month 8.

2. Mediqueue
I. General Information Project Title: MediQueue: A mobile queuing and teleconsult scheduling app for rural health units, Startup Name: Barangay Health Tech Inc. Date Established: August 10, 2025; Total Funding Requested: PHP 980,000.00 Project duration: 10 months

II. Problem: Patients at rural health units in Liloan wait an average of 3 hours in physical lines for consultations, with no way to check queue status remotely. RHU staff reported that in 2025 walk-in overcrowding cause 1 in 4 patients to leave before being seen.

III. Solution: MediQueue lets patients reserve a queue number via SMS or an app, view estimated wait time, and opt into a video teleconsult slot for follow-up cases that don't require a physical exam.

IV. Target Market: Rural health unit patients and staff in Liloan, beginning with the two RHUs in Barangay Catarman & Barangay Yati, where a 6-month pilot is already run.

V. Objectives: 1.) Expand from 2-to-8 RHUs across northern Cebu by month 6 2.) Cut average physical queue wait time by 50% across partner RHUs by month 8 3.) Reach 5,000 registered patients accounts by month 10.

3. SakayScan
I. General Information: Project Title: SakayScan: A QR-based fare & route tracking system for public utility jeepneys Startup name: Ruta Digital Solutions, Date Established: June 2026, Total funding Requested: 340,000 PHP Duration: 6 months

II Problem: Commuters in Cebu City have no reliable way to track jeepney routes or verify correct fares under the new distance-based fare matrix, leading to frequent disputes between riders & drivers.

III Solution: SakayScan is a QR sticker placed at the jeepney entry & exit points that commuters scan to log boarding and alighting stops, and auto calculating the correct fare and giving drivers a digital route log.

IV Target Market: Commuters and jeepney operators along Cebu City South Bus Terminal-Talisay route, starting with 1 operator cooperative that has expressed willingness to test.

V Objectives: 1) Complete a feasibility and willingness-to-pay study with 3 jeepney cooperatives by Month 2 2) Build & test a working QR prototype in 5 jeepney units by Month 4. 3) Secure a signed pilot agreement with at least 1 cooperative by Month 6.

4. Balik Basura

I. General Information: Project Title: Balik Basura: A waste segregation and junk shop marketplace app, Startup Name: Greenloop Mandaue, Date Established: March 2025, Total Funding Requested: PHP 1,750,000.00, Project Duration: 12 Months.

II. Problem: Households in Mandaue struggle to find reliable junk buyers for segregated recyclables - an estimated 55% of recyclable waste still ends up in general garbage collection, per a 2024 city ENRO waste audit.

III. Solution: Balik Basura connects households to nearby junk shops through an app showing live buying prices per material type, schedules pickup, and lets junk shops manage inventory & route their collectors more efficiently.

IV. Target Market: Households and junk shop operators in Mandaue City, currently active in 6 barangays with 300 registered households and 4 subscribing junk shops.

V. Objectives: 1) Expand to 15 barangays and 1,000 registered households by Month 6 2.) Grow subscribing junk shop partners from 4 to 20 by Month 9. 3.) Reach break-even on junk shop subscription.

5. Eskwela Ko

I. General Information: Project Title: Eskwela Ko: An Offline-First Supplementary Learning App for Public Elementary Students in Far-Flung Barangays; Startup Name: Aprende Learning Systems Date Established: Nov 2025, Total Funding Requested: 780,000 PHP, Duration: 9 months.

II. Problem: Public Elementary students in far-flung mountainous barangays of Cebu province have unreliable or no internet access, limiting them to physical modules for supplementary learning. Teachers report widening grade-level reading gaps since the shift back to in-person classes.

III. Solution: Eskwela Ko is an android app pre-loaded with grade-appropriate reading & math exercises via SD card or occasional school Wi-Fi sync, tracking student progress offline and syncing results to teacher dashboards when connectivity is available.

IV. Target Market: Public elementary schools in the mountain barangays of Asturias & Balamban, starting with 3 partner schools identified through the DepEd division office.

V. Objectives: 1) Finalize content mapping to the DepEd MELCs for Grade 3-5 by Month 3 2) Deploy a working prototype to 3 pilot schools by Month 6 3) Reach 300 active student users with measurable progress tracking by Month 9.

I. General Information
Project Title : AgriLink: Direct-to-Consumer Agricultural Marketplace
Startup Name : AgriTech Innovations Inc.
Date Established: May 12, 2020
Total Funding Requested : PHP 2,200,000.00
Project Duration : 12 months

II. Problem
Smallholder vegetable farmers in Benguet lose up to 35% of their potential income to middleman markup and post-harvest spoilage.
Current cooperative logbooks are handwritten, making crop yield forecasting inaccurate and lead times unpredictable.

III. Solution
AgriLink is a hybrid USSD and Android marketplace that lets farmers log harvested crops via simple SMS or app interface. Algorithms aggregate supply in real time and match produce directly with commercial buyer orders in urban centers.

IV. Target Market
Commercial kitchens, restaurant chains, and wholesale vendors across Metro Manila, sourcing directly from 400 registered farmers in La Trinidad.

V. Objectives
1.) Onboard 200 active farming households within the first 6 months.
2.) Reduce average post-harvest delivery transit delays by 40%.
3.) Facilitate PHP 5,000,000 in direct crop transactions by Month 12.

A. Project Metadata
Title: AquaSense: Smart Water Quality Monitoring for Milkfish Aquaculture
Lead Organization: BioAqua Sensor Labs
Filing Date: June 18, 2026
Budget Allocation: PHP 1,450,000.00
Execution Period: 8 months

B. Problem Statement
Fish kill incidents in Pangasinan cause millions in losses annually due to sudden drops in dissolved oxygen levels. Manual water testing is conducted only once daily, failing to alert fish cage operators to dangerous nocturnal oxygen shifts.

C. Technical Proposal
Deploy floating solar-powered IoT sensor buoys that measure pH, temperature, and dissolved oxygen continuously. Sensor data transmits via LoRaWAN to a local server, pushing automated SMS alarms to cage managers when levels cross critical thresholds.

D. Beneficiary Group
Commercial tilapia and milkfish cage operators in Bolinao and Dagupan, targeting an initial cohort of 45 licensed aquaculture farms.

E. Project Milestones
• M1 (Month 2): Hardware prototype assembly and waterproof enclosure testing
• M2 (Month 5): Deployment of 15 pilot sensor buoys across 3 test zones.
• M3 (Month 8): Zero unalerted oxygen crash events reported in pilot cages

Field Name | Data Input
Project Name | Barangay Pass: Digital Resident Identity & Gate Pass
Developer / Entity | CivicPulse Solutions
Creation Date | July 04, 2026
Grant Target | PHP 250,000.00
Timeline | 6 months

Problem Summary
Barangay clearance issuance relies on physical logbooks and paper receipts, resulting in long queues during peak hours. Records verification requires manual cross-checking against physical filing cabinets.

Proposed System Workflow
1. Registration: Residents generate a dynamic QR code profile via a lightweight web app or community kiosk.
2. Verification: Barangay staff scan the QR code to verify identity against an encrypted local database.
3. Issuance: Automated printing of certificates with digital cryptographic signatures.

Target Users
Barangay administrative staff and over 15,000 residents across Barangay Luz and Barangay Lahug.

Expected Outcomes
• Reduce physical document processing time from 25 minutes down to 3 minutes.
• Eliminate paper file loss across pilot barangay halls.
• Achieve 80% resident adoption within 5 months of rollout.

1. Overview
Project Name : ColdChain Guard (IoT Fleet Temperature Logger)
Organization: FleetLogix Systems
Proposal Date : August 10, 2024
Funding Required: PHP 1,750,000.00
Term : 9 Months

2. Context & Problem
Refrigerated transport trucks carrying vaccines and fresh meat lack verifiable temperature logs during transit.
Temperatures spikes often go unnoticed until delivery destination inspection, resulting in high cargo rejection rates.

3. Proposed Solution
A tamper-evident hardware logger that attaches to refrigerated containers. It records temperature and humidity every 30 seconds onto a local cryptographic ledger, syncing to cloud dashboards when cellular connection is restored.

4. Pilot Scope
Regional cold-chain logistics providers operating refrigerated trucks along the Pan-Philippine Highway route between Luzon and Visayas.

5. Performance Indicators
• 100% data fidelity during offline transit segments
• Immediate real-time alerts for temp deviations exceeding 2 degrees Celcius
• Adoption across 30 long-haul transport vehicles during pilot phase

fields.scope: The pilot scope focuses on regional cold-chain logistics providers operating refrigerated trucks along the Pan-Philippine Highway route between Luzon and Visayas, covering deployment across 30 long-haul transport vehicles over a 9-month project timeline.
fields.methodology: The team will manufacture and install tamper-evident IoT loggers on 30 target fleet vehicles, integrate local cryptographic logging for offline data retention, configure automated cloud syncing via cellular connectivity, and evaluate performance using continuous 30-second temperature logs and real-time threshold alert tracking.

Project Identifier : PRJ-2026-MED09
Project Title : RxScan : Automated Handwritten Prescription Digitization
Applicant : HealthByte Software
Requested Capital : PHP 2,500,000.00
Timeline : 12 months

1) Operational Deficit
Pharmacy staff spend an average of 45 seconds per order deciphering handwritten doctor prescriptions, leading to fulfillment delays and a 4.2% rate of medication dispensing errors in community pharmacies.

2) System Architecture
RxScan utilizes a fine tuned vision-language model trained on medical shorthand and doctor handwriting styles. Pharmacy technicians capture a photo of the paper prescription; the system extracts drug names, dosages, and frequencies, cross-checking them against an integrated pharmaceutical database for dosage safety.

3) Target Deployment
Independent community pharmacies and hospital outpatient dispensaries in Metro Cebu, targeting 50 operational pilot counters.

4) Quantifiable Targets
• Target 1: Achieve 94% OCR accuracy on handwritten prescription scans
• Target 2: Reduce average prescription verification time to under 10 seconds
• Target 3: Process over 50,000 prescriptions during the 6-month trial phase without critical dosage error.
